note: Boss taunts: short text lines on the HUD message line, per boss (keyed by the boss display name in public/world/area-content.json). Kinds: spawn (first within spawnRange of the player), aggro (the boss turns on the player), hurt (health at or below hurtShare, once), death (after the boss is defeated). A line is shown only when no game message is live (never over 'Switched to X.'), at most one per minGapSeconds, held up to waitSeconds for the line to clear; higher kinds replace a waiting lower one. maxChars keeps a line on the HUD line. Off switch: ?taunts=0.

spawn: Hold still. Everything is cheaper that way.
aggro: Don't flinch. I charge by the cut.
hurt: That's a clean wound. I'll leave it open.
You bleed like all the others.

spawn: Wipe your feet. I just washed the floor.
aggro: Fresh stock walking in on its own.
hurt: You'll fetch less than I hoped.
Keep swinging. I've seen worse cuts.

aggro: Turn back or go in the river.
hurt: I've held this bridge through worse.
death: Bridge is yours. Good luck with it.
Somebody else can mind the gate.

spawn: The grid went dark. The fire stayed.
aggro: Come closer, love. It's cold out.
hurt: You'll smell of smoke for a week.
death: Let it burn out. I'm done.

spawn: I've been behind you since the tunnel.
aggro: Run. It makes the walk worth it.
hurt: Lucky. Don't count on it twice.
I only need you to slip once.
death: You were quieter than me. Once.

spawn: No trains. No law. Just me.
aggro: I break things. You're next on the list.
hurt: Hit me again. See what it costs you.
death: Lock the doors on your way out.

spawn: Curfew's in force. Drop your weapon.
By the old statute, you're under arrest.
aggro: Hands where I can see them.
hurt: I've taken harder hits than that.
death: Order's gone. Make what you will of it.
